jackhammer-gloves.title: Jackhammer, outdoors (gloved)
jackhammer-gloves.look_at: Both "gloved hand" boxes are on the ear defenders and the "bare hand" box is on the tool pouch; the yellow-gloved hands themselves are missed. Outdoor, eye-level photos are unlike the overhead factory cameras it was trained on.

red-work-glove.title: Red work glove, close-up
red-work-glove.look_at: The only box is a "bare hand" on the worker's head; the large red glove is missed. Close-ups are far from the training data, where hands are small and seen from above.

metal-sheet-gloves.title: Handling a metal sheet (gloved)
metal-sheet-gloves.look_at: Nothing detected, though a red-gloved hand is in view.

welding-gloves.title: Welding (gloved)
welding-gloves.look_at: Nothing detected: thick welding gloves seen close up never appear in the training data.

lab-nitrile-gloves.title: Lab, nitrile gloves
lab-nitrile-gloves.look_at: Nothing detected on two clearly gloved hands.

machine-operator-bare-hands.title: Machine operator (bare hands)
machine-operator-bare-hands.look_at: Nothing detected: the bare hands holding a phone are missed. Missed bare hands are this model's main failure, even on its own validation data.

salt-worker-distant.title: Salt workers, distant (bare hands)
salt-worker-distant.look_at: One "gloved hand" box, on the basket. The workers' hands are tiny; small hands are found 6-25% of the time even on training-like data.

tools-no-hands.title: Tools, no hands
tools-no-hands.look_at: Correctly empty: no hands, no boxes.
